extension.description: XSCleaner keeps your Kodi installation clean and fast. Features include cache cleanup, thumbnail management, database optimization, backup/restore, advanced settings editor, and more.
XSCleaner hält Ihre Kodi-Installation sauber und schnell. Funktionen umfassen Cache-Bereinigung, Thumbnail-Verwaltung, Datenbank-Optimierung, Backup/Restore, Advanced Settings Editor und mehr.
extension.disclaimer: Use at your own risk. Always backup before making changes.
Verwendung auf eigene Gefahr. Erstellen Sie vor Änderungen immer ein Backup.
extension.news: v1.4.0 - Change: Caught-up (missed) automatic backups now run in the background with a banner notification instead of blocking the UI with a progress dialog — Kodi stays fully usable while the backup runs; the missed-backup dialog now mentions that the backup runs in the background - Change: WebDAV password and Dropbox credentials (App Key, App Secret, Refresh Token) are now stored encrypted in the addon settings (encryption key kept in the addon data folder) and shown as masked password fields in the settings dialog — no more plaintext credentials on screen or in settings.xml; existing plaintext values are migrated automatically v1.3.9 - Fix: More reliable and faster cleanups and backups — chunked stream downloads, single-pass storage scan, safer database/thumbnail cleanup, silent-mode progress fixes, removed dead code - New: Optional Dropbox backup destination (dropbox://) with never-expiring refresh token; setup via new Dropbox settings group and bundled dropbox_token.py helper - Perf: Large backups upload in chunks (upload sessions) and download in streams - Fix: WebDAV backup folders no longer falsely report "not writable" (probe verified by read-back); reliable folder creation; failed write probes are removed - New: WebDAV credentials (server URL, user name, password) stored in the addon settings under Backup > WebDAV and injected into dav:///davs:// paths at run time; new "WebDAV (Nextcloud/ownCloud)…" entry in the backup folder browser, "Test WebDAV connection" button and help texts for every field; existing davs://user:pass@ paths keep working v1.3.8 - Fix: Missed scheduled auto-backups are offered at the next Kodi start even when no backup has ever run — the scheduled time is now persisted and moved forward after each handled slot - Fix: dav/davs (WebDAV) backup folders can now be selected and created — Kodi only creates whole folder trees for local/SMB/NFS paths, WebDAV folders are now created step by step and bogus remote file sizes are ignored v1.3.7 - New: Scheduled automatic full backups with configurable interval and hour, run silently by the service - New: Missed scheduled backups are offered at the next Kodi start - Fix: Backup folder browser showed files instead of subfolders (wrong element of xbmcvfs.listdir read) - New: "Choose this folder" as first highlighted browser entry, "Edit Backup Path" jump, pre-filled manual path input - New: Progress dialog while navigating SMB/NFS/FTP folders and during the network write check - Change: Hidden system folders starting with "@" are hidden in the folder browser v1.3.6 - New: Addon Storage — browse addons and addon data by disk usage (sizes cached) - Change: Dashboard sizes always measured fresh;
